stories.title: Rory McIlroy's BMW Redemption — Returning to Bellerive After St. Jude Horror

x_posts.label: Post 3
x_posts.text:
Rory McIlroy finished 66th at the FedEx St. Jude. 8-over. Not one sub-par round.

Now he goes to Bellerive — a course that rewards exactly what McIlroy does best.

Three-time FedExCup champion. He's not done yet.

#PGATour #RoryMcIlroy

stories.title: Jordan Spieth at BMW — FedExCup Dream Alive After Near-Miss in Memphis

x_posts.text:
Jordan Spieth: 15 straight BMW Championships.

Nearly missed it this year — entered St. Jude ranked 54th, outside the top 50. Bogey-free 65 in R1 saved him.

Winless in 2026. Needs top 30 at Bellerive to reach East Lake.

#PGATour #JordanSpieth
